questions.q: What does Darren Hardy credit 99% of his success to?
a: Hard work
His mentorship under Jim Rohn
His early entrepreneurial experience
His natural talent for writing
questions.why: The overview states he still credits 99% of his success to hard work.

questions.q: According to the text, what should you do the moment you come up with a new life goal?
a: Instantly turn it into a tiny, daily habit you can practice
Set a specific deadline within one week
Share it with a group of supportive friends
Write a detailed plan for the next month
questions.why: The daily habit lesson says to instantly turn a new goal into a tiny daily habit.

questions.q: What physics analogy does the text use to explain momentum in habits?
a: A snowball rolling down a hill getting bigger and faster
A pendulum swinging back and forth with decreasing force
A rocket accelerating through stages of fuel burn
A ball bouncing lower with each successive impact
questions.why: The routine lesson compares momentum to a snowball rolling down a hill, picking up more snow.

questions.q: What did Arnold Schwarzenegger do when he hit weight lifting limits?
a: He'd lean back to activate more muscle groups and add reps
He'd switch to lighter weights for an entire week
He'd hire a personal trainer to redesign his program
He'd take a full rest day before attempting again
questions.why: The push through limits lesson describes how he leaned back to get support and add five to six reps.

questions.q: What was true about Darren Hardy when he started his first entrepreneurial venture?
a: He had no experience, no connections, and no clue what to do
He had a business degree and a small savings fund
He had a mentor who guided him through the process
He had already published several self-help articles
questions.why: The overview says he started at 18 with no experience, no connections, and no clue what to do.
